### 1. `MAVEN_RELEASE_QUALIFIERS` regex (requirement 11)
Made the leading `version[-._]` portion optional and appended `\d*` so `RELEASE`/`FINAL`/`GA` followed immediately by digits (e.g. `RELEASE802`) is recognized as a stable release marker. This makes a `RELEASE802`-style current version compatible with stable candidates (`true`) and incompatible with pre-releases (`false`), while still matching bare or delimited qualifiers.

### 2. New git-SHA constants + regex (requirements 3, 8, 9)
```ruby
MIN_GIT_SHA_LENGTH = 7
MAX_GIT_SHA_LENGTH = 40
GIT_COMMIT = /\A(?=[0-9a-f]{7,40}\z)(?=.*[a-f])/i
```
Requires 7–40 hex chars **and** at least one `a-f` letter (rejects all-numeric and out-of-range/oversized suffixes).

### 3. `matches_dependency_version_type?` — git SHA check
Inserted after the JRE/JDK check and before the exact-suffix comparison:
```ruby
return true if contains_git_sha?(current_suffix) || contains_git_sha?(candidate_suffix)
```

This makes two SHA-bearing versions **or** just one SHA-bearing version resolve as the same type (requirements 1 & 2).

- `git_sha?` — strips an optional leading `v` and tests against `GIT_COMMIT` (requirement 4).

### 5. `extract_version_suffix` catch-all
Changed the final branch from "return only if it contains `-`/`_`" to **return any non-empty suffix**.
